description: Drafts or audits a research data management plan and the personal-data section of a proposal, for NWO, ERC and Horizon Europe, or an institutional template built on the Science Europe core requirements. Covers data description, documentation, storage and security, GDPR handling of survey and text data including special-category data and text sent to hosted model APIs, retention, sharing, repository and license, and costs. Use when writing the data management section of a grant proposal, the full plan due after an award, or the data paragraph of an ethics application, or when checking an existing plan before it goes to a data steward. The publication archive itself goes to replication-package.
